Fitness & Health Calculators

Calories Burned Calculator

Determine the calories burned during physical exercises using MET standards.

Inputs

Calculations & Results

Calories Burned (kcal)
-

Formula & Mathematical Equations

\text{Calories} = \text{MET} \times 3.5 \times \frac{\text{Weight (kg)}}{200} \times \text{Minutes}

How It Works & Explanation

MET (Metabolic Equivalent of Task) quantifies the intensity of activities, relative to sitting at rest.
